decisions.finding: Ken's repeated public corrections of Iris during team meetings, combined with disputed task ownership and tense exchanges in front of colleagues, created an unprofessional and uncomfortable working environment. While Ken's intent was not to undermine Iris, the impact of his behavior was disruptive. The underlying undocumented handoff process contributed to task ownership confusion, but does not excuse the pattern of public corrections. Ken's four observed incidents are noted as part of the record. A corrective working arrangement is warranted.

commitments.detail: No direct one-to-one meetings between Iris and Ken for 30 days. Weekly mediated check-ins will be held instead, with Darius available to support mediation.
Document the handoff procedures between Iris and Ken to address the root cause of task ownership confusion.

A separate private support meeting with Iris as complainant will be scheduled independently of this group review, per policy.
